name: Bookmarks 1.0 UI on a movie's details page (script tag from the kit's index.html middleware)

steps.name: index.html carries the Bookmarks script tag once, from the middleware and not from File Transformation
steps.waitFor: fetch(new URL('index.html', location.href), { cache: 'no-store' }).then(r => r.text()).then(t => t.split('data-jfbm-plugin').length === 2 && !t.includes('data-bookmarks-plugin'))

steps.name: the page loaded the Bookmarks script
find Long Test Movie
steps.eval: (await ApiClient.getItems(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), { IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie', Recursive: true, SearchTerm: 'Long Test Movie', Limit: 1 })).Items[0].Id

steps.name: the movie has a bookmark (created once through the API)
steps.script: const itemId = __vars.movieId; const list = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks', { itemId: itemId })); if (list.length === 0) { await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks'), data: JSON.stringify({ ItemId: itemId, StartTicks: 150000000, Note: 'webcheck' }), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' }); } return (await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks', { itemId: itemId }))).length;

steps.name: the My bookmarks section is shown (1.0's 'Bookmarks' section, so named since 1.1)
the Add bookmark button is shown
no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag excepted)
